summary: Wiener declined to call Gaza's destruction genocide when directly asked in a January 2026 debate, saying so only in a follow-up video after sustained criticism. He earlier affirmed a Jewish state, opposed ceasefire resolutions as fueling antisemitism, and co-authored AB 715, a classroom-oversight bill CAIR California warned could censor Palestine teaching. A California Jewish Democrats 'Support' endorsement and Vote for Peace's 'Opposed' rating sit alongside his opposition to offensive arms sales and support for Iron Dome.
